subject.title: fix(models): authenticate Anthropic discovery with OAuth tokens

question: Should a successful Anthropic live discovery response augment the shipped Anthropic model baseline, or is removal of manifest-only models for subscription users an intended compatibility change?
rationale: The authentication repair is mechanically clear, but the shared catalog's replacement semantics become newly observable for OAuth users and choosing whether to preserve existing models is a product compatibility decision.

options.title: Preserve the shipped baseline
options.body: Merge accepted live Anthropic rows into the shipped provider catalog and add regression coverage for manifest-only entries.

options.title: Accept replacement semantics
options.body: Land the OAuth repair while explicitly accepting that successful discovery may remove manifest-only Anthropic models from OAuth users' listings.

options.title: Pause for catalog policy
options.body: Defer this PR until maintainers define one consistent live-catalog composition policy for Anthropic and other providers.

recommendation.title: Preserve the shipped baseline
recommendation.body: Merge accepted live Anthropic rows into the shipped provider catalog and add regression coverage for manifest-only entries.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the recent merged Anthropic live-catalog work and can provide the clearest implementation and compatibility context.
